summary.name: Hummingbird
summary.one_liner: Hummingbird is a macOS utility that lets you move and resize windows by holding a shortcut key and dragging anywhere inside the window.
use_cases: Moving windows on large Mac displays without travelling to the title bar
Resizing windows from any edge or corner without clicking past them
Nudging background windows into view without rearranging the stack
Dragging windows on macOS Big Sur where the title bar is smaller
summary.what_it_does: Hummingbird lets you move and resize windows by holding a modifier shortcut key and using the cursor anywhere within the window's bounds. The page says it was made to fix window dragging on macOS Big Sur, where the draggable title bar area was reduced. Move and resize controls cover the whole window rather than only the title bar. Resizing from inside the window avoids accidentally clicking a background window through its edge, which the page says helps trackpad users. The page also describes nudging background content into view without disturbing the window stack.
notable: Move and resize windows from anywhere inside the window by holding a modifier key
Built to fix window dragging after the macOS Big Sur title bar change
Resize without clicking through to background windows, useful for trackpads
caveats: Offered as a 14 day free trial; the page does not state full pricing
